The operating vendor directly providing **Telegram Messenger** at **telegram.org** is **Telegram Messenger Inc.**

### Provider Statement & Evidence
According to the official **Telegram Privacy Policy** at `telegram.org/privacy`:
> *"This Privacy Policy sets out how we, **Telegram Messenger Inc.** (“Telegram”), use and protect your personal data that you provide to us, or that is otherwise obtained or generated by us, in connection with your use of our cloud-based messaging services (the “Services”). For the purposes of this Privacy Policy, 'we', 'us' and 'our' refers to Telegram..."*

*(Note: Telegram also lists affiliated operational entities within its group—such as Telegram FZ-LLC based in Dubai, which acts as the publisher on several mobile app stores—while Telegram Messenger Inc. serves as the primary contracting entity providing the service on telegram.org).*

record.description: Telegram is a cloud-based instant messaging service that emphasizes speed and security. The platform offers free, encrypted messaging, voice calls, and video calls, which are available across multiple devices such as smartphones, tablets, and computers. Telegram is renowned for its focus on user privacy, offering features such as self-destructing messages and secret chats. Founded in 2013 by Pavel Durov, Telegram has become a global leader in secure messaging communication, operating its headquarters from Dubai, UAE. It offers both personal and business solutions through its API, supporting developers and businesses globally.
